title: Funnel doors, the /vs comparisons, page templates, block defaults, llms.txt and JSON-LD stop saying free sells
detail: PHASE 6 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). lib/marketing/funnel-config.ts, lib/marketing/comparisons.ts, lib/page-editor/templates/*, components/page-editor/blocks/dawn.tsx and collections.tsx (a typed $4.99 outside the figures scan), app/llms.txt, app/llms-full.txt and lib/jsonld.ts offers. Shipped 2026-10-06: the /for doors quote tips at 0% on the free row and the Business fee once per introduced customer, with per-door step-ups that name charging (and Collective for community builders); the /vs comparisons and both /vs pages say hosting is free and selling starts at Business; the spaces, what-is-frequency and how-to-start-a-circle templates and the PlanBand and Tiers block defaults drop every free-sells line (the typed Crew floor and the Founding Steward price are gone from collections.tsx); llms.txt and llms-full.txt read PLAN_STORY.selling and quote fees only for plans that take payments; /pricing JSON-LD carries a Collective Offer from the catalog, covered by a jsonld test; the how-to-start-a-circle help article no longer says every plan sells a membership. Published copies of these templates in the pages table keep the old words until the owner re-publishes them.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const bad=[["lib/marketing/funnel-config.ts",/[Ss]ell from day one/],["lib/marketing/comparisons.ts",/selling open on a free/i],["app/llms.txt/route.ts",/NOT gated on any tier/],["app/llms-full.txt/route.ts",/NOT gated on any tier/],["components/page-editor/blocks/collections.tsx",/\$4\.99/]].filter(([f,re])=>re.test(r(f))).map(([f])=>f);for(const f of fs.readdirSync("lib/page-editor/templates"))if(/free Space sells|every rung sells/i.test(r("lib/page-editor/templates/"+f)))bad.push(f);if(!/[Cc]ollective/.test(r("lib/jsonld.ts")))bad.push("lib/jsonld.ts has no Collective offer");if(bad.length)fail("old model still on: "+bad.join(", "));console.log("ok: public surfaces tell the ladder")'
